rules.heading: Goal
rules.text: Bid the tricks you will win, then win them.

rules.heading: Modes
rules.text: Standard: 24 deals. 1–8 cards up, 4 nines, 8–1 down, 4 blind nines. Quick 9s: 4 nines.

rules.heading: Trump
rules.text: Up to 8 cards: the top card is flipped. Nines: the player left of the dealer names it.

rules.heading: Bidding
rules.text: Name the tricks you will win. Hook: the dealer bids last and may not make the bids add up to the cards dealt.

rules.heading: Scoring
rules.text: Bid met: 50 per trick plus 50. All tricks bid and won: 100 each. Bid 0, take 0: 50. Missed: 10 per trick won. Penalty (khishti): bid but take none: {P}.

rules.heading: Jokers
rules.text: 2 jokers replace the black 6s. A joker may always be played. Leading one: take, demand a suit or trump, or play under.

rules.heading: Blind 9s
rules.text: Bid first, then see your hand.
